observations.body: Paul appeals for Onesimus as brother, self, and received guest. Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate, Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
observations.label: Paul appeals for Onesimus as brother, self, and received guest

payload.posture: Read Philemon 1:8–22 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul appeals for Onesimus as brother, self, and received guest. Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate, Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
